mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_assessment_record ( user_id, assessment_no, questionnaire_version, answers, total_score, risk_level, ip_address, device_info, started_at, completed_at, expire_at, is_completed, is_current, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{assessmentNo}, #{questionnaireVersion}, #{answers}, #{totalScore}, #{riskLevel}, #{ipAddress}, #{deviceInfo}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{expireAt}, #{isCompleted}, #{isCurrent}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, assessment_no, questionnaire_version, answers, total_score, risk_level, ip_address, device_info, started_at, completed_at, expire_at, is_completed, is_current, created_at, updated_at FROM risk_assessment_record WHERE assessment_no = #{assessmentNo} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE risk_assessment_record SET is_current = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_current = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, assessment_no, questionnaire_version, answers, total_score, risk_level, started_at, completed_at, expire_at, is_completed, is_current FROM risk_assessment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_completed = 1 AND is_current = 1 ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE risk_assessment_record SET questionnaire_version = #{questionnaireVersion}, answers = #{answers}, total_score = #{totalScore}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, ip_address = #{ipAddress}, device_info = #{deviceInfo}, started_at = #{startedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, expire_at = #{expireAt}, is_completed = #{isCompleted}, is_current = #{isCurrent}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
